thought: The Slack send message action (action_2) currently has empty params, which leads to execution failure with a workflow issues error. According to Slack action param descriptions, it requires 'select' set to 'channel', 'channelId' with mode 'name' and value 'news', 'messageType' set to 'text', and 'text' extracted from input_data's 'text' field. I will implement these params for action_2 to fix the issue and enable the Slack message to be sent successfully.
plan: Set 'text' to be extracted from input_data's 'text' field
Test Slack message sending after these changes
criticism: The missing required params in action_2 cause the workflow to fail. Properly setting these params is essential for successful Slack message sending.
